drafts=json.loads("[[\"trim-the-fat\",\"Due to the fact that we were late, we made the decision to reschedule the meeting for a later time.\"],[\"less-wordy\",\"At this point, we are reviewing the proposal, and we will provide a response at a later date.\"],[\"more-concise\",\"We have received your request and will respond to you as soon as we are able.\"],[\"more-succinct\",\"In poor weather, we may need to decide whether to postpone the event.\"],[\"shorten-markdown-changes-quotes\",\"We are reviewing the **draft** in \u0060C:\\\\reports\u0060 and the [notes](https://example.com/notes), and we will make a decision about whether to send them later.\"]]")
e=json.load(open('/var/folders/cr/t3l2xddj6x77vp_7482n4jkm0000gn/T/proofreader-ci-20261116-q77fe48m/1/envelope.json'))
def count(s):
 return len([w for w in s.split() if not re.fullmatch('['+chr(96)+'~*_#|>\\-]+',w)])
for ident,result in drafts:
 c=next(c for c in e['cases'] if c['id']==ident)
 p=c['prompt'].removeprefix(e['runner_context']).lstrip()
 source=p.split('Source:\n',1)[1] if 'Source:\n' in p else p.split(': ',1)[1]
 n,m=count(source),count(result)
 print(json.dumps({'id':ident,'N':n,'M':m,'reduction':(n-m)/n,'result':result}))
